input.quote: On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.
input.rationale: Section 10 covers only loss of access, Deliverable delivery and refunds; it refers to "any agreed transition period" but imposes no transition-assistance obligation, and nothing in the Agreement requires return of Customer Data in a usable format or certified deletion (Section 16.5 carves Customer Data out and cross-refers to a non-existent Section 11). New Section 10.3 inserted at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination (no longer request-gated), and deletion with written certification thereafter.

ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause because the Agreement gives us no right to our data back or to migration help on termination. The 30-day return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format now runs from expiry or termination rather than from a request, with deletion and written certification thereafter.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance for up to 6 months at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter.

Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format.
